description:
Observed during the initial SCRUM-726 diagnostic on staging, before the successful ramp and two-hour soak. A newly created ZZ TEST scripted till was assigned receipt, kitchen and band printers in its create request. Its receipt and kitchen jobs nevertheless ended as skipped with NO_DEVICE_FOR_ROLE. Later jobs printed. The two skipped historical records are preserved, not rewritten as successful.

Known source: 5069944660dfd43571d39f097aa90a77b1092c36. Dedicated hosted test box 01a19e80-5ac5-78f7-9778-edf58a06783c; station 01a19f07-f5bb-79c0-91d9-240a1744a0b0. The jobs finished at 2026-11-03T01:31:07Z. Independent read-only cleanup job-dbkum4rncjis73fd52ig found 474 printed, these two skipped, zero queued/failed and zero box-queue rows. All fixture stations, box and three simulated printers are now retired. No physical Pi behavior is claimed.

Reproduce with a new ZZ TEST hosted box and till, assigned simulated printers, then an immediate one-item cash sale. Compare the saved assignments with the agent configuration available at the first print. A configuration-refresh race is a hypothesis, not an established cause. Determine whether the same timing affects a physical agent in the separate bench.

Done when: explain and pin the first-sale behavior, ensure valid newly saved assignments are honored without duplicating a sale or print, preserve intentional no-printer skips, add a focused regression if a defect is confirmed, and attach inspected staging proof. Do not change payment semantics or retry a cash request. Evidence: docs/qa/proof-2026-11-03/s726/database-cleanup.json and print-cleanup-api-read.json; harness Rig.station passes the device assignments when creating the till. Follow-up to SCRUM-726; not a capacity failure in the completed measured interval.
